description: Language-neutral golden cases for Syrmos 3.0 Phase N J07 unified freshness/offline presentation. One shared rule derives the banner state from the existing DataFreshness rule: evaluate(isNetworkAvailable, isLive) -> live | predicted | offline. Offline (no network) always wins over liveness; online-but-not-live is predicted (the 'online yet the API is unreachable/stale' case a connectivity-only check would miss); online + live is live. showsBanner is true whenever the state is not live. Kotlin com.syrmos.core.common.FreshnessPresentation, web web-freshness.js and iOS FreshnessPresentation must produce the EXACT expected result for each case.

cases.note: online with fresh live data: no banner
online but no fresh live data (API unreachable/stale): predicted, banner shown
no network overrides a stale 'live' flag
no network and no live data: offline
